items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I had him on the arranging staff, when I organized the other band.

ctx.x: Yeah, Jack Oglesby was a very fine musician and arranger, because I had him on the arranging staff, when I organized the other band.

Okay, but I'll tell you how this come out, though. We toured quite a few places around in the state with this Passing Pass in Review, and then we came back to Chicago after a few months out of Chicago, touring all around and in Iowa and what have you. And then this show, I think Leo booked the show South.
